title: bardolier eject --all output
description: down-all once, then every mounted removable root, best-effort. cli-spec.md §6 (Lifecycle / SSD). A blocked disk never throws here — it is one entry in `results` with `ejected: false` and its own `holders`, so a stuck disk cannot hide a clean one.

stopped.description: Projects down-all stopped on the way, sorted.

results.description: One entry per candidate root, in configured order.

holders.description: Who still held it, when ejected is false. Empty on success.

docker_stopped.description: True when the Docker engine had to be stopped for this volume specifically.

message.description: The refusal's own sentence, when ejected is false.

holder.description: A process holding files open on the SSD, as lsof reports it — the same shape eject.schema.json uses.
